column3: BootUI 2.4.0 skips null header names in HttpServletRequest/HttpServletResponse (BootUiHttpExchangesFilterTests.skipsNullRequestHeaderNamesWithoutLosingValidHeaders, skipsNullResponseHeaderNamesWithoutLosingValidHeadersOrTheServedBody); in ASGI 3.0, scope and response headers are binary (bytes, bytes) pairs and null header names cannot occur.
